items.description: Cybercriminals are now exploiting remote monitoring and management tools to spread dangerous malware while avoiding detection by security systems. The attack campaign targets users who download what appears to be popular software, such as Notepad++, 7-Zip, or ChatGPT, from fake websites. items.title: New Wave of Steganography Attacks: Hackers Hiding XWorm in PNGs
items.description: ANY.RUN experts recently uncovered a new XWorm campaign that uses steganography to conceal malicious payloads inside seemingly harmless PNG images. What appears to be an ordinary graphic actually contains encrypted loaders that execute entirely in memory, allowing the malware to bypass most traditional detection methods and signature-based defenses.
